text:
deploybot: Deploy scheduled: v2 -> public-route at 2026-04-02T22:00Z. Rolling to 20% canary for 30m, then 60% for 15m, then 100%. Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/rn/2026-04-v2
alex_k: Heads-up — mobile SDK 4.2 still defaults to v1. If >2% mobile traffic hits v2 we should hold. @mobile-team please confirm readiness. :eyes:
priya: Can we add a header gate so legacy clients stay on v1? Prefer using `X-Redwood-Api-Version`/client-version pin. I'll add a release notes snippet now: "v2 brings streaming, stricter JSON shapes, and improved KV-cache".
tom: Proposed rollback triggers: error rate > 0.8% sustained for 1m, p95 latency > 1200ms, or client schema errors > 0.2% — trigger immediate revert to v1 and page oncall. Documenting in ops playbook.
elena: Note: Dedicated customers need opt-in route. We'll exclude dedicated:true tenants from the initial canary. @sales FYI to inform any affected accounts.
ops: Ops: canary percentages are controlled by deploybot flags. I'll watch infra + telemetry. Suggest synthetic probe: 25 requests with ~512 token payloads to validate KV-paths and streaming behavior.
alex_k: +1 to probes. Suggest adding a non-breaking fallback: if v2 schema mismatch, include header `X-Vers-Fallback: v1` and return legacy wrapper so clients don't error out.
priya: Release notes updated: https://redwood/docs/release/2026-04-v2. Migration snippet for SDKs included:
```
// Node SDK example
await client.request({ headers: { 'X-Redwood-Api-Version': '2' } })
```
tom: I'll ship a tiny mobile SDK patch to flip the header (3 lines). Also recommend throttled ramp if mobile errors go from 0.1% -> 0.5% within a 10m window.
deploybot: Deploybot: Starting canary step 1 -> 20% (operator: ops). Canary window started at 22:00Z. Monitoring hooks: infra, telemetry, client-schema. :eyes: :rocket:
ops: Observed small EU p95 bump +80ms, no error increase so far. Holding at 20% for full 30m and watching schema error rate. Eng oncall standing by.
alex_k: If anything spikes, add route rule to pin mobile to v1: `match X-Client-Type: mobile -> route=v1`. @deploybot can you apply pin if needed?
deploybot: Deploybot: Applied pin rule r-xyz — mobile traffic routed to v1. Canary remains at 20%. :white_check_mark:
